title: Complete Quake Console Core Implementation
description: Finish ConsoleController with input buffer, tokenizer, parser, dispatcher, history, autocomplete, and scrollback. Ensure toggle with backquote/tilde works reliably.

title: Implement Console Command Registry
description: Create reflection-based discovery system that finds all [ConsoleCommand] decorated classes and registers them for dispatch.

title: Create ConsoleOverlayUI Prefab
description: Build the UI prefab with TextMeshPro for input line and scrollback area. Should be overlay-style, toggleable, and visually distinct from Serial Terminal.

title: Implement Serial Command Infrastructure
description: Create ISerialCommand interface, SerialCommandAttribute, and dispatcher that mirrors real Purity command output from logs/PDFs.

title: Create Lsblk Command with Error Paths
description: Implement lsblk command showing device tree output. Include happy path with USB detected and error paths for missing USB and wrong device path. Cite sources from Docs/PuttyLogs.

title: Create Mount Command with Error Paths
description: Implement mount <dev> <path> command with success case, 'already mounted', 'not a block device', and 'no media present' error paths. Cite sources from Docs/PuttyLogs.

title: Create Minimal SimulationState Class
description: Stub out SimulationState as single source of truth for arrays, controllers, shelves, ports, cables, power, media/USB state. Serializable/checkpointable design.

title: Create Minimal WorkflowEngine
description: Stub out WorkflowEngine with workflow steps, CanJumpIn/CanJumpOut guards, and basic step management for console commands to integrate with.

title: Create Console Parser Tests
description: Unit tests for console tokenizer and parser logic using NUnit in Editor folder.

title: Create Golden Transcript Tests
description: Create PlayMode tests comparing Serial command output byte-for-byte with transcribed expected files from Docs/PuttyLogs.

title: Document Dual Console Architecture
description: Update repository documentation to clearly explain the separation between Serial Terminal (operational commands) and Quake Console (simulator control).
